record.field: The package must belong to a company before an SSCC can be generated.
Company "%(company)s" has no SSCC company prefix configured.
Company "%(company)s" has an invalid SSCC company prefix "%(prefix)s". It must contain only digits.
Company "%(company)s" has an SSCC company prefix "%(prefix)s" that is too long.
Company "%(company)s" has an invalid SSCC extension digit "%(digit)s". It must be a single digit.
Company "%(company)s" has no SSCC sequence configured.
The SSCC serial reference "%(serial)s" must contain only digits.
The SSCC serial reference "%(serial)s" exceeds the allowed length of %(length)s digits.
The SSCC "%(sscc)s" must contain exactly 18 digits.
The SSCC "%(sscc)s" has an invalid check digit. Expected %(expected)s.
Production "%(production)s" has no pending output move to generate a pallet output.
Move "%(move)s" has no package quantity or package configured.
Move "%(move)s" has no boxes per pallet configured on its package.
Move "%(move)s" must have a lot to generate a pallet SSCC.
